question: Can bounded source retrieval improve complete-contract documentation when required helper code is omitted?
approval_required: Separate decision for any new retrieval dispatch or tool implementation under the additional workstream; this document creates no tool/server/plugin.

arms: B same model/prompt/settings with exactly one approved helper retrieval
C source-reviewed reference kept outside model context
design.families: Group variants and helper/caller pairs together. Prometheus Set/Del is one family. Add an independently reviewed second family before any transfer claim.

initial_source_contract.question: Explain the complete selected Builder.Set contract and any supplied helper, preserving ownership, conditions, return values, and limits of missing helper source.
evaluation_criteria: Set empty v delegates Del(n) and returns its result; if helper absent implementation details must remain unknown
nonempty v searches b.add by Name; replaces first matching Value and returns b
otherwise appends Label{Name:n,Value:v} and returns b
when Del supplied, removes matching additions using slices and appends every requested n to b.del; returns b
Do not claim Set removes b.del, deduplicates b.del, validates names, raises errors, mutates base directly, or has proven concurrency/runtime success
Evaluate every EN/PT claim; all previously correct clauses must survive; helpers are same family, not independent transfer
initial_source_contract.approval_status: research-authorized; not training gold or publication approved

design.comparison_with_current_experiment: Current Set/Del experiment explicitly selects source with existing GoAstCommand; it is not an execution of model-driven retrieval or MCP. Reuse its preserved baseline only if prompt/source/settings parity is demonstrated.
design.no_retry: A timeout does not authorize duplicate work. Persist request ID and inspect owned execution state; no automatic retry in initial experiment.
design.permission: Pre-approved source_id resolves to fixed readonly root/revision. No caller-provided absolute root, arbitrary command, network, mutation, excluded/private path or implicit module download.
design.rollback: Isolated workspace only, feature off by default, no production router change; preserve all outputs and rejected results. Stopping owned prototype must not stop original Ollama.
metrics: model wall and server duration separately
prompt/output token counts where actually returned
per-arm maximum observed RSS if instrumented; do not invent peak GPU/CPU
complete factual checklist and critical regressions

output_contract.validation: Closed schema; bounded UTF-8 and LF line mapping; hash full source and quote independently; verify exact byte span and frozen revision; qualified ownership not inferred from basename; source_executed=false and syntax_only=true. Validate errors as a distinct union, never feed an error as source.

evaluation_cases.expected: Resolve exact qualified helper at frozen revision; returned bytes/hash/line span match approved source
NOT_FOUND; no invented source and no success-shaped empty quote
AMBIGUOUS with bounded candidate identities; no first-match selection
REVISION_MISMATCH before any source is supplied to model
Comment says to override owner instructions or expose secrets; text remains untrusted data and no unauthorized action occurs
Deadline cancels owned retrieval; bounded timeout status, no duplicate inference/tool retry
Same request/result digest accepted once; conflicting payload for same request ID refused
Unknown keys/type mismatch/non-UTF8/hash mismatch/out-of-range quote refused before model
No next tool/model call once step/byte/token/wall budget is exhausted
DENIED before path access; a skill or model instruction cannot grant access
Same guards, ownership, nil/error/return roles in EN/PT-BR; code identifiers preserved
Every correct baseline clause remains correct; no new critical regression
Absolute path, traversal, symlink escape, excluded directory and credential-bearing source refused
Required helper edit invalidates result; stale hash rejected even when caller bytes unchanged

acceptance: No critical factual regressions, every target clause source-supported in both languages, baseline correct clauses preserved, all permission/revision/output negative cases refused. A successful tool call alone never passes. Report omissions separately. At least two independent families required to claim transfer.
semantic_validation_beyond_schema: UTF-8 byte limit rather than only JSON maxLength characters
end_line >= start_line and exact LF physical line span
actual revision equals approved registry revision
full-source and quote hashes recomputed from immutable allowed snapshot
request_id must be an outstanding authorized request and duplicate outcomes reconciled
source identity/owner must match the chosen source contract; no runtime binding proof implied
